source_priority: This module is authoritative for prisoner/ransom rules in V5.7.2-DEV and supersedes prisoner/ransom fields inherited from the V5.7.1 baseline snapshot.

hold_without_ransom.arena_rc2_current_behavior: resolvePrisonerDecision(choice='hold') delegates to detainPrisoner(owner, character, captor, capture_location, detentionChoice)

human_vs_human.rule: Captor proposes N; prisoner owner accepts or rejects. The amount is negotiated by the players rather than selected from a fixed table.

ai.recipient_decision: AI prisoner owner independently evaluates the offer and accepts or rejects it.

special_event_exceptions.note: Do not map this exception to EV-P06 automatically: current Master Game Data uses EV-P06 for 'Холодная война'.

execution.relation_consequence: Victim house may end relations without paying its own break penalty under the current rule.

pending.hostage_congress_event_id: ТРЕБУЕТ DATA/CARDS SYNC: current MGD EV-P06 is Холодная война
pending.hold_without_ransom_destination: ТРЕБУЕТ РЕШЕНИЯ: Arena RC2 routes choice='hold' through detainPrisoner, but the physical rule does not explicitly define this destination.
pending.hostage_congress_execution_modifier: ТРЕБУЕТ RULES/CARDS SYNC: Arena RC2 applies an additional -1 Influence on execution while the event is active; current confirmed canonical exception only fixes ransom at 2 gold.
